caption: A paper map is unfolded on the hood of a car and smoothed flat.

sa.check: A folded paper map is on the hood of a car.
The unfolding comes first and the smoothing follows.

pc.expect: The map opens along its existing creases and gets larger as it opens without changing its total size.
pc.fail: It opens with no creases; or grows beyond its folded panels; or shrinks.

pc.expect: It lies flat only where pressed and springs up slightly at the folds.
pc.fail: It is a rigid plate; or stretches; or snaps flat by itself.

pc.expect: It opens only as the hands move it.
pc.fail: It opens by itself; or refolds itself; or slides off the hood.

pc.expect: The panels lie on the hood, not through it.
pc.fail: The map passes through the hood; or the hands pass through the map; or a panel passes through another.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The map's printing and the car stay the same.
pc.fail: The printing changes; or the car changes colour; or the background rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
